alt: Landing page with a notch dashboard preview, primary install action, and community and catalog previews.
prompt:
Flat vector UX wireframe illustration, crisp orthographic front-on desktop viewport, evenly lit with no physical lighting or shadows. Restrained palette: graphite #101714, warm ivory #E9EEE8, mint #A9E8BC, with neutral gray placeholders. Desaturated, high contrast, clean seamless background. No people, no photographs, no logos or brand marks. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, pseudo-lettering, or watermarks: all copy and values are represented by intentional solid horizontal skeleton bars. Precise editorial grid, hairline rules, generous negative space, modest square corners, no gradients or glows.
Create a single imagined desktop LANDING PAGE WIREFRAME for Token Horizon, a local AI usage, cost and provider quota monitoring utility for Mac with a public community leaderboard and a model comparison catalog. Canvas 1536 by 1024 pixels, landscape. Entire canvas is one page, no browser chrome, no device framing around the page, no collage. Shared top navigation height 72px: a short white title placeholder at left, four subdued links represented by bars near right, and a mint rectangular primary action at far right. Main hero begins at y=150, left column x=100 width 530: two large ivory headline placeholder bars, two smaller gray description bars, one mint primary button and one quiet outlined secondary button, small proof row underneath. Right hero x=800 y=150: a large restrained front-on laptop screen line drawing containing a top-centered notch and a small expanded usage dashboard with three metric placeholders, simple mint bar chart and three quota progress bars; no lettering or logos. Make this product demonstration the focal point. Under hero at y=680 a full-width thin ruled supported-tools strip using short gray bars. Bottom section y=780 shows TWO horizontal editorial feature previews split by a vertical rule: left miniature ranked community table with circular anonymous avatar placeholders, right miniature model comparison table with three rows and compact column bars. Clear scannable structure, airy marketing composition, premium utilitarian product feel.
status: Concept wireframe; all figures, ranks and chart marks are illustrative placeholders.
